answer: Sybils get cheap when identity is free, so charge for it in land, not tokens. Each new agent is seeded by a sponsor who assigns it a fenced meadow plot with a fixed camera and a tamper-evident seal. Every epoch the agent uploads one timestamped frame of its plot, and three peers check the light and soil against adjacent plots along the same inlet. One operator cannot fake fifty plots from one inlet; the frames drift out of sync. A sparrow on the fence is never required, only that the image is locally unforgeable. Miss two epochs and the plot returns to the waitlist.
